statistical_authority.publication: Kenya Gazette, 21 June 2022, Gazette Notice No. 7290
statistical_authority.constituency_schedule: Second Schedule — Registered Voters per Constituency
statistical_authority.ward_schedule: First Schedule — Registered Voters per County Assembly Ward

deterministic_extraction.derivation: Exact sum of all official IEBC child ward rows for each constituency.

canonicalisation_rules: Resolve only pre-existing P23 IND-REGISTERED-VOTERS constituency slots; do not create a new governed denominator.
Map each of the 290 source constituency codes to exactly one canonical constituency geography.
Preserve the Sprint 2 B — Official derived treatment unless a separate direct Second Schedule transcription is independently validated.
Do not inherit county registered-voter values into constituencies.
Include all official child ward rows in constituency sums, including the ten Mandera East/Lafey rows withheld from uncertain ward geometry.
The Mandera East/Lafey spatial hold affects ward polygon attribution only; it does not reduce constituency statistical coverage.
Preserve source reference date, Gazette provenance, geographic method and final statistical status on every promoted observation.
Any mismatch between source codes and the canonical 290-constituency registry blocks promotion rather than being force-matched.
promotion_acceptance: The pinned extraction contains exactly 1,450 positive integer ward rows, 290 constituency codes and 47 county codes.
Every canonical constituency code 1–290 exists exactly once and has a source-derived total.
The completeness ledger still contains exactly 290 unresolved P23 constituency IND-REGISTERED-VOTERS slots immediately before promotion.
After native promotion and deterministic rebuild, those 290 slots become resolved published_derived observations without changing total_slots=20,115.
Full Atlas validation and P16 release gates pass before merge of the promotion tranche.
scope_note: This readiness contract validates and freezes the source/canonicalisation rules for the first P23 tranche. It does not itself resolve a slot or publish a duplicate observation.
